title: Representations of currents that agree on an open set have the same weight there
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and S, T ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ m), with integer multiplicity representations R_S, R_T (IMRep univ m; R_S.Represents S, R_T.Represents T). Let O ⊆ ℝ^P be open such that S(ω) = T(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ O. Then the weights agree on O: μ_{R_S}⌞O = μ_{R_T}⌞O, i.e. R_S.measure.restrict O = R_T.measure.restrict O.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (RS RT : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (O : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen O → RS.Represents S → RT.Represents T → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ O → S ω = T ω) → RS.measure.restrict O = RT.measure.restrict O
